summary: {resident} brings the last pool receipt to the counter when a new session costs more than expected.
realLife: Portland's activity discount lasted twelve months from enrollment rather than ending on a common calendar date.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a discount expiration date, session date and rate in effect.

turns.pulledBy: A base-rate increase falls between sessions and the discount expires as well.
turns.what: The clerk separates the two changes on the quote.
turns.writesBack: The family receives a renewal date and the current price.

turns.pulledBy: A base-rate reduction takes effect after the discount expires.
turns.what: The clerk calculates what renewal would save at the lower rate.
turns.writesBack: The new receipt lists the discount actually used.
